legend: After learning the basics of matrices, Derar wants to learn the newest matrix algorithm "Matrix Bel Lotus."
Ahmad, its author, gave Derar n$$$n$$$ videos. Video i$$$i$$$ is di$$$d_i$$$ minutes long.
Derar has T$$$T$$$ minutes before the contest, and he has to watch all the videos. He can't skip a video, but he can watch video i$$$i$$$ with any of the following speeds:
X1$$$1$$$ speed: he will need di$$$d_i$$$ minutes and will get 100$$$100$$$ skill points.
X1.5$$$1.5$$$ speed: he will need di1.5$$$\frac{d_i}{1.5}$$$ minutes and will get 75$$$75$$$ skill points.
X2$$$2$$$ speed: he will need di2$$$\frac{d_i}{2}$$$ minutes and will get 50$$$50$$$ skill points.

It is guaranteed that di$$$d_i$$$ is a multiple of 6$$$6$$$. So it can be proven that all the values in the problem are integers. And it is guaranteed that Derar can watch all the videos if he plays them at speed X2$$$2$$$.
You have to help Derar choose the speed of each video so he can watch all the videos in at most T$$$T$$$ minutes and maximize the total sum of skill points.
input: The first line contains a single integer tc(1≤tc≤100)$$$tc \: (1 \leq tc \leq 100)$$$ — the number of testcases.

The first line of each testcase consists of two integers n,T(1≤n≤2⋅105)(1≤T≤1010)$$$n , T \: (1 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5) (1 \leq T \leq 10^{10})$$$ — the number of videos and the number of minutes Derar has before the contest.

The second line of each testcase consists of n$$$n$$$ integers di(1≤di≤1010)$$$d_i \: (1 \leq d_i \leq 10^{10}) $$$ — the duration of each video. It is guaranteed that di$$$d_i$$$ is a multiple of 6$$$6$$$.
It is guaranteed that the sum of n$$$n$$$ over all testcases doesn't exceed 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$ , and Derar can watch all the videos if he plays them at speed X2$$$2$$$.
output: The output of each testcase consists of two lines:
On the first line, print the maximum sum of skill points Derar can achieve.
On the second line, print n$$$n$$$ values, the speed he will watch each video with. The values should be 1,1.5$$$1 , 1.5$$$ or 2$$$2$$$.
If there are multiple solutions, print any.

legend.ai: 在学习矩阵的基础知识后，Derar 想学习最新的矩阵算法 "Matrix Bel Lotus"。
其作者 Ahmad 给了 Derar n$$$n$$$ 个视频。视频 i$$$i$$$ 的时长为 di$$$d_i$$$ 分钟。
Derar 在比赛前有 T$$$T$$$ 分钟，他必须看完所有视频。他不能跳过某个视频，但可以以以下任意速度观看视频 i$$$i$$$：
X1$$$1$$$ 速度：他需要 di$$$d_i$$$ 分钟，并将获得 100$$$100$$$ 点技能点。
X2$$$2$$$ 速度：他需要 di2$$$\frac{d_i}{2}$$$ 分钟，并将获得 50$$$50$$$ 点技能点。
保证 di$$$d_i$$$ 是 6$$$6$$$ 的倍数。因此可以证明，题目中的所有数值都是整数。并且保证如果 Derar 以 X2$$$2$$$ 的速度播放视频，他可以观看完所有视频。
你需要帮助 Derar 选择每个视频的播放速度，使他能在不超过 T$$$T$$$ 分钟内观看完所有视频，并最大化技能点总和。

input.ai: 第一行包含一个整数 tc(1≤tc≤100)$$$tc \: (1 \leq tc \leq 100)$$$ —— 测试用例的数量。
每个测试用例的第一行包含两个整数 n,T(1≤n≤2⋅105)(1≤T≤1010)$$$n , T \: (1 \leq n \leq 2 \cdot 10^5) (1 \leq T \leq 10^{10})$$$，分别表示视频的数量以及 Derar 在比赛前拥有的分钟数。
每个测试用例的第二行包含 n$$$n$$$ 个整数 di(1≤di≤1010)$$$d_i \: (1 \leq d_i \leq 10^{10}) $$$，分别表示每个视频的时长。保证 di$$$d_i$$$ 是 6$$$6$$$ 的倍数。
保证所有测试用例中 n$$$n$$$ 的总和不超过 2⋅105$$$2 \cdot 10^5$$$，并且 Derar 以 X2$$$2$$$ 的速度播放时可以看完所有视频。

output.ai: 每个测试用例的输出包含两行：
第一行输出 Derar 能获得的技能点数总和的最大值。
第二行输出 n$$$n$$$ 个值，表示他观看每个视频时所采用的速度。这些值应为 1、1.5$$$1 , 1.5$$$ 或 2$$$2$$$。
如果有多个解，输出任意一个。
